summary: CR-358-P2 QA Pass Complete - All 13 handover test cases PASS, 4 regression tests PASS, 3 smoke tests PASS. New Booking (S3) and Check-In (S4) pages fully functional with real preprod APIs.

issues: KPI values show '...' placeholder during initial load (~2-3 seconds). Acceptable UX with loading state.
Room pills show skeleton loading for ~3-5 seconds on page load. Acceptable UX.

TC01.description: New Booking page renders with all 4 sections: Guest Details, Room Selection, Stay & Amount, Booking Summary + Booking Type cards

TC02.description: Room Selection loads 5 room pills (r1-r5) with Home icon, room number bold, type (Suite/Executive) + ID (8524-8528)

TC03.description: Booking Summary updates live as Name, Phone, Room, Check-in, Check-out, Adults, Children, Amount are filled

TC04.description: Form validation: Save as Booking + Walk-in buttons disabled when invalid (name empty, phone not 10 digits, no room, amount=0). Both enabled when valid

TC05.description: Check-In page renders with KPI strip (4 tiles: 1 Arriving Today, 3 In-House, 0 Checkout Today, ₹19,922.28 Outstanding), Walk-in banner, Arrivals list

TC06.description: Arrivals list loads 4 pending arrival cards with guest name, channel pill (Direct green, booking.com blue), dates, nights badge, meal plan badges

TC07.description: Clicking arrival card shows 'Selected' chip, populates right panel with guest name, phone, room assignment, dates, amount, booking type info

TC08.description: Walk-in button activates walk-in mode: shows amber walk-in pseudo-card at top of arrivals list, right panel shows blank form with 'Walk-in' label

TC09.description: Room type mismatch warning (amber chip with Info icon) appears when changing room from executive to suite type

TC10.description: New Booking 'Walk-in · Check In Now' button navigates to /pms/check-in with prefilled form data (name, phone, room, amount transferred)

TC11.description: Check-In page 'New Booking' header button navigates to /pms/new-booking

TC12.description: Empty panel shows BedDouble icon + 'Select an arrival or start a Walk-in' text (data-testid='ci-panel-empty' exists in DOM)

TC13.description: Sidebar component renders, localStorage key 'mygenie_sidebar_expanded' used for persistence

REG01.description: /pms/channel-manager loads with Room Mapping tab, shows Executive and Suite room types with availability

REG02.description: /pms/in-house loads with KPI tiles (4 In-House, 0 Checkout Today, ₹19,922.28 Outstanding, 2d Avg Nights) and guest table with 4 rows

REG03.description: Dashboard accessible after login with Dine-In (2 tables) and Room (4 rooms) sections visible

REG04.description: Order entry page loads from table click - shows menu categories, items, cart functionality

SMOKE01.description: Full login flow: enter credentials → boot screen completes (~15-20s) → lands on /dashboard with sidebar visible

SMOKE02.description: Sidebar has 'Rooms' content visible. Child items (New Booking, Check-In, In-House, Channel Manager) are in collapsed submenu - expected behavior

SMOKE03.description: After testing PMS pages, return to /dashboard - no crash, dashboard content loads correctly
